name: Swapside
summary: One card with sign-in and sign-up: a liquid colour panel sweeps across to swap them
about: A login and registration card that holds both forms. Pressing Create account or Sign in sends a coloured panel sweeping across the card with a stretchy, liquid edge, and the other form slides in underneath. A chameleon on the panel changes colour with the side you are on, watches you type with two independent eyes and celebrates in rainbow colours when you get in.
how: Start on Sign in: fill the demo details or type your own while the chameleon's eyes follow the caret
Press Create account on the panel: it stretches, sweeps to the other side and settles, and the sign-up form slides in
On phones the panel sits on top and a colour curtain pours down to swap the forms
Focus a password and the chameleon shuts both eyes and curls its tail; Show password lets one eye peek
Submit to see the button turn into a progress ring, then a tick with confetti and a rainbow chameleon, or a cross and a grey, frowning chameleon
Sign out or Start over resets the form, and Sign in on the panel sweeps it back
